notes.title: RHYTHMIC Joins VRForever!
notes.content: [h1]VRForever!![/h1][p]We are super excited to participate in the first ever VRForever Steam event! [/p][list][*][p]130 participating games[/p][/*][*][p]From today Sept. 18th to 23rd[/p][/*][*][p]Deep discounts[/p][/*][*][p]New demos and releases[/p][/*][*][p]First-ever VRForever Awards - 30 nominated games in 6 categories[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]It's gonna be wild! Here we goooo.. [/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist RHYTHMIC or play the demo for free now![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.4.2.0
notes.content: [h3]Right in Time for VRForever [/h3][p]As we are approaching the VRForever Steam Event on Sept. 18. we wanted to make sure to get this out to everyone in time![/p][p]We are super excited to participate and happy to be part of this great and quickly growing VR community on Steam![/p][p][/p][h1]New:[/h1][list][*][p]DEMONS! New minions have come to besiege the people of Dengshi Valley![/p][/*][*][p]There is a proper pause menu and score/lose screen available now in game from which the session can also be abandoned or restarted![/p][/*][*][p]The map of the tutorial has been completely remade. It now takes place directly inside the sanctum of the Prime Sorceress![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Improvements:[/h1][list][*][p]You can now cancel dialogues of Drog and Bog in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]The controller feedback when collecting mana is increased now[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix V0.4.1.2
notes.content: [h1]Improvements:[/h1][list][*][p]Switching between leaderboards is much faster now[/p][/*][*][p]Made credits spawn as full text which is faster and more efficient[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced non-visible foliage in main menu for performance gains[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list][*][p]Hand poses were incorrect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed infinitely respawning credits menu globes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Polish[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed that some particles in the main menu portal activation were just hanging in the air[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.4.1.1
notes.content: [h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][olist][*][p]Implemented support for names with Japanese, Korean, and Chinese characters which were previously not displayed at all in the leaderboards. ごめんね, 미안해, 对不起.[/p][/*][*][p]The enrage mechanism for the monster enemies works correctly again.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance and reduced loading times.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Update V0.4.1.0
notes.content: [h1]Dear all,[/h1][p]thanks so much to the early players who gave me amazingly useful feedback! I used that to improve some things in the demo. [/p][p]This update brings the following changes:[/p][p][/p][h1]Changes:[/h1][olist][*][p]Added coloured halos around enemies to show which magic types they have a weakness towards (receiving 2.5x damage from that magic type)[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the enemy spawning algorithm which is much more robust, leaner and makes it much easier to control enemy spawn probabilities in a data driven fashion[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the introduction tutorial! Made it [b]shorter[/b] and incorporated the new halo system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of enemies by increasing their contrast towards the environment[/p][/*][*][p]Some performance optimisation[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the range of the earth spell so it shoots roughly as far as the other spells when using similar force[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][olist][*][p]Fixed a bug where player sometimes received more damage than intended from shooters on higher difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Some internal menu bugs[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.4.0.1
notes.content: [h1]Changes[/h1][olist][*][p]Increased strength of assisted throwing in Easy difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Raised earth spell slightly from the ground to make it more visible[/p][/*][/olist][p]       [/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][olist][*][p]Menus show their names now as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Hands close completely when grabbing magic spells[/p][/*][/olist]
